documents.text: Surveillance Impact Report — Automated License Plate Recognition. Prepared under the Seattle Surveillance Ordinance, SMC 14.18, a policy of the Seattle City Council. This policy document describes the rules governing use of the surveillance technology, the retention period for collected data, the audit and oversight policy, and the data sharing policy. The ordinance requires Council approval before acquisition and annual review of the approved policy.

fields.value: all ALPR data is deleted after 90 days
SPD's Audit Unit can conduct an audit at any time; the Office of Inspector General and the Seattle Intelligence Ordinance Auditor also have audit authority

fields.raw_value: SPD has no data sharing partners for ALPR; outside entities obtain records only through criminal-prosecution disclosures

fields.value: ALPR antennas are conspicuously mounted on marked SPD vehicles
